Scavenging Farming
Note: a Table of Contents can be found in the pins.
​
Introduction
Scavenging  is an  perk which provides players a chance to get uncommon or rare components as a drop, whenever they kill an NPC.
​
⬥ Each rank provides a 1% chance per rank for uncommon components to drop from a kill, with a 1% chance that they will be rare components instead.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scavenging 4  on level 20 equipment provides a 4.4% chance per kill, of activation, with a 1% chance that the components will be rare instead of uncommon.
⬥ Check the wiki for more information about Scavenging 
⬥ Killing monsters en masse for  procs is called scav farming, a low effort/AFK way to obtain a variety of components.
​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Visit the wiki's perk calculator to calculate your chances at lower  levels.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure you use an

Useful Items and Unlocks


















⬥ Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.

Items
⬥ Scripture of Ful 
    • Activate to increase your kph, with no extra inputs required
⬥ Scripture of Bik 
    • Ensure  is toggled off for  to trigger during combat. Can still have bone collector toggled on
⬥ Spirit weed incense sticks  and Lantadyme incense sticks 
    • Passively increase your kph, and the duration of your potions
⬥ Holy aggroverload 
    • Upkeep, or place in a 
⬥ Weapon with Caroming 4 
Abilities
⬥ Magma Tempest 
⬥ Greater Chain 
⬥ Greater Sunshine 
Other
⬥ Totem of Summoning 
⬥ Luck of the Dwarves (relic power) 
    • Allows you to increase your kph by wearing a better ring
⬥ Death Note (relic power) 
    • Allows for automatic looting of noted bones in conjunction with the 
⬥ Smoke devil  with Dust Cloud scrolls 
    •  allows your familiar to use its special move more often
    • Ensure familiar combat mode is default, and the autofire rate is set to 1








​
Where to use Scavenging
Besides dedicated farming via  (method below), it's a convenient perk to have for passive profit when engaging in any activity which requires killing large amounts of enemies. Consider bringing an armour piece with  if doing:
​
⬥  Slayer creatures - Check out #rs3-slayer for details on methods. Examples include:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Nightmares - Popular AFK moneymaker, doable on and off-task.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Vyres - Popular combat method for training  and 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Abyssal beast - Popular combat method for AFK gp and clues.
⬥ Champion scroll farming.
⬥     Elite Dungeons - More effective for trash runs.
⬥  Gathering clues via combat.
​
Lumbridge Catacombs
After completing The Blood Pact quest, the Lumbridge Catacombs are unlocked.
​
⬥ This is the most effective location to farm for scavenging procs.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There aren't any noteworthy drops besides the occasional Skeleton Champion's scroll.
⬥ The catacombs are southeast of the Lumbridge lodestone 
​
Method: Skeletons ~4300 kph , ~5150-5400 kph 

⬥ Go to the bottom floor and walk south-east then south, to where you find the Topaz statuette.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand on the tile shown above, 2 north and 1 west of the pillar in the center of the room.
​
Preset
⬥ Magic (Seasingers) 
⬥ Magic (Power Armour) 
⬥ Melee (Tetsu) 
⬥ Melee (Power Armour) 



















⬥ With Melee  a minimum hit of 2100 with Purifying Light is necessary to obtain optimal kph.
    • This can be achieved with the following: Reaper Crew, salve amulet (e) , Equilibrium 1  Undead Slayer , and Ruthless 3 
    • It is still possible to achieve optimal kph if using ports armour (offstyle works), this allows for ports resource crates via the set effect.

Setup with Equilibrium 1  Undead Slayer 
⬥ If using t95 (t100)  with , an additional damage bonus of 133 (86) is necessary.
    • If using , you only need an additional damage bonus of 53 (7).
    • If using  you only need an additional damage bonus of 91 (43).
    • If using  with  you only need an additional damage bonus of 11 (0).
Alternative with Equilibrium 4  Undead Slayer 
⬥ If using t95 (t100)  with , an additional damage bonus of 61 (15) is necessary.
    • If using , additional damage bonus is not necessary.
    • If using , you only need an additional damage bonus of 18 (0).
    • If using  with , additional damage bonus is not necessary.

Chaos Dwarf Battlefield
After completing the Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf quest, the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield is unlocked.
​
⬥ This location hosts an abundance of mobs which are profitable to kill.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chaos dwogres, chaos dwarves and hand cannoneers can all drop the dragon pickaxe 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Chaos dwarf hand cannoneers can drop the hand cannon 
⬥ The Chaos Dwarf Battlefield can be easily accessed by using a  to teleport to Keldagrim, and running south past the Giant Dwarf statue, then following the southwestern path to the cave entrance.
​
Method: Dwogres ~2400 kph

⬥ Stand on the left tile, and place your  or  on the right tile.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  yields a higher kph but is more expensive.
​
Preset
⬥ Magic 

​
Ability Bar

​
Example Kills
⬥ Dwogre Magic ~2400 kph
​
Waterbirth Island Dungeon
The Waterbirth Island Dungeon doesn't require any quests to be unlocked, and hosts an abundance of mobs which can be killed to farm for scavenging procs.
​
⬥ This location is notable because at ~3950 kph, you can expect ~2000 crimson charms per hour.
⬥ The Waterbirth Island Dungeon can be easily accessed via the enchanted lyre.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires the hard Fremennik achievements to be completed.
​
Method: Dagannoths ~3950 kph

⬥ Stand and place your  on the tile shown above.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Line yourself up with the rock in the water, then walk 6 east and 1 north from the edge of the water.
​
